1.word_for_word: एकाशीतितमे सख्युर् जग्ध्वा पृथुक-तण्डुलान् । — On the eighty-first day, the friend ate a piece of rice.; श्रियं निर्मितवान् इन्द्र- दुर्लभां तु तद्-आश्रमे ॥ — In that āśrama he created opulence, which is rarely found by King Indra.; सङ्कथयन् सुख-गोष्ठीः कुर्वन् । — Talking and having happy conversations.; सर्व-भूतानां मनसोऽभिज्ञः । — He is aware of the minds of all beings.; मद्-अर्थं पृथुकान् आनीय दातुं लज्जित इति जानन्न् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१॥ — This means that he knew that he was ashamed to bring the pieces and give them for my sake.
1.translation: On the eighty-first day, the friend ate a piece of rice. In that āśrama he created opulence, which is rarely found by King Indra. Talking and having happy conversations. He is aware of the minds of all beings. This means that he knew that he was ashamed to bring the pieces and give them for my sake.

2.word_for_word: प्रहसन् क्ष्वेलीं कुर्वन् ॥२॥ — laughing and joking.

3.word_for_word: लज्जया त्व-कथयतस् ताम् अपनुदन्न् आह---अण्व् अपीति द्वाभ्याम् ॥३॥ — Embarrassed to tell her, he removed her and said, "Anv, too, with two.
3.translation: Embarrassed to tell her, he removed her and said, "Anv, too, with two.

6.word_for_word: सर्व-भूतानाम् आत्म-दृग् अन्तः-करण-साक्षी ॥६॥ — He is the Self-seeing and the witness of the innermost beings of all beings.
6.translation: He is the Self-seeing and the witness of the innermost beings of all beings.

7.word_for_word: अमर्त्यानां देवानाम् अपि दुर्लभाः ॥७॥ — They are rare even for the immortal gods.
7.translation: They are rare even for the immortal gods.

8.word_for_word: अति-जीर्णत्वाद् वसनस्य पुनस् तन्-मध्ये चीरेण बद्धान् ॥८॥ — Because of the very worn outness of the garment they were again tied in the middle of it with a rag.
8.translation: Because of the very worn outness of the garment they were again tied in the middle of it with a rag.

9.word_for_word: अङ्ग हे सखे । — Ang, O friend.; मं विश्वं विश्वात्मानं माम् ॥९॥ — I am the universe, I am the universal soul.
9.translation: Ang, O friend. I am the universe, I am the universal soul.

10.word_for_word: इति वदन्न् एकां मुष्टिं जग्ध्वा । — Saying this, he swallowed a fistful.; तत्-परा इति । — That-beyond is.; अयं भावः---एतावता पुंस इहामुत्र च मत्-कटाक्ष-विलास-भूतानां सर्व-संपदां समृद्धयेऽलम् । — This is the sense that it is enough for a man to enjoy all the wealth of beings who enjoy My gaze here and hereafter.; अतः परं द्वितीय-मुष्ट्य्-अदनेन मा माम् एतद् अधीनां कुर्व् इति ॥१०॥ — From now on, do not make me subject to this by eating a second fist.
10.translation: Saying this, he swallowed a fistful. That-beyond is. This is the sense that it is enough for a man to enjoy all the wealth of beings who enjoy My gaze here and hereafter. From now on, do not make me subject to this by eating a second fist.

11.word_for_word: त्वत्-तोष-कारणं तव तोषस्य कारणं यथा भवेत्, तथा सर्व-संपत्-समृद्धये । — The cause of your satisfaction is the cause of your satisfaction, and the prosperity of all wealth.; यां भक्तस्य समृद्धिं दृष्ट्वा त्वं तुष्येर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥११॥ — This means that you will be pleased to see the prosperity of your devotee.
11.translation: The cause of your satisfaction is the cause of your satisfaction, and the prosperity of all wealth. This means that you will be pleased to see the prosperity of your devotee.

13.word_for_word: श्वो-भूते उदिते रवौ । — The sun rose in the morning.; विश्वं भावयतीति विश्व-भावस् तेनेति पुरतो भाविनाम् इन्द्र-दुर्लभं विभवं सूचयति । — The fact that he feels the universe, and that he feels the universe, indicates the rare power of Indra in the future.; स्व-सुखेन स्वानन्द-पूर्णेनेति दानेऽदीनतां दर्शयति, नन्दितो विनयोक्तिभिः ॥१३॥ — He shows his humility in giving, saying that he is full of his own happiness and joy, and is delighted with humble words.
13.translation: The sun rose in the morning. The fact that he feels the universe, and that he feels the universe, indicates the rare power of Indra in the future. He shows his humility in giving, saying that he is full of his own happiness and joy, and is delighted with humble words.

14.word_for_word: व्रीडितः स्व-वित्तकार्पण्येन लज्जितः । — He was ashamed and ashamed of his own financial greed.; महतः श्री-कृष्णस्य दर्शनेन निर्वृतः सुखं प्राप्तः ॥१४॥ — He was satisfied and attained happiness by seeing the great Lord Krishna.
14.translation: He was ashamed and ashamed of his own financial greed. He was satisfied and attained happiness by seeing the great Lord Krishna.

15.word_for_word: निर्वृतिम् एवाह---अहो इति चतुर्भिः । — He said, “Oh, I’m satisfied.”; यद् यतः लक्ष्मीम् उरसि बिभ्रता आश्लिष्टोऽहम् ॥१५॥ — Whenever I carried Lakshmi on my chest I embraced her.
15.translation: He said, “Oh, I’m satisfied.” Whenever I carried Lakshmi on my chest I embraced her.

16.word_for_word: पापीयान् नीचः ॥१६॥ — The sinful and the lowly.

18.word_for_word: पूजितश् चन्दन-लेपनादिभिः ॥१८॥ — He was worshiped with sandalwood paste and other ointments.
18.translation: He was worshiped with sandalwood paste and other ointments.

19.word_for_word: एवं संपूज्यापि धनस्यादाने कारणं कल्ययति---स्वर्गापवर्गयोर् इति द्वाभ्यं ॥१९॥ — Even after worshiping in this way he calculates the cause of giving wealth, namely, heaven and liberation.
19.translation: Even after worshiping in this way he calculates the cause of giving wealth, namely, heaven and liberation.

20.word_for_word: स्वर्गादीनां यद्य् अपि तस्य चरणार्चनम् एव कारणं तथापि कारुणिकत्वाद् अभूर्य् अपि स्वल्पम् अपि धनं मह्यं नाददात् ॥२०॥ — Although worship of His feet was the only cause of heaven and other attainments, yet out of compassion He did not give me even a small amount of wealth.
20.translation: Although worship of His feet was the only cause of heaven and other attainments, yet out of compassion He did not give me even a small amount of wealth.

21.word_for_word: इत्य् एवं चिन्तयन्-निज-गृहस्यान्तिकं तत् प्रान्तम् । — Thinking thus, he reached that province near his own house.; तस्य विशेषणं सूर्येति ॥२१॥ — Its attribute is the sun.
21.translation: Thinking thus, he reached that province near his own house. Its attribute is the sun.

22.word_for_word: विचित्रोपवनादिभिर् वृतम् । — It is surrounded by wonderful gardens and other places.; कथं भूतैः । — How about the ghosts.; कूजद्भिर् द्विज-कुलैः पक्षि-समूहैर् आकुलैर् व्याप्तैः । — It was surrounded by flocks of chirping twins and anxious flocks of birds.; तथा प्रोत्फुल्लानि कुमुदादीनि येषु तानि वारीणि येषु तानि तथा तैः ॥२२॥ — The same is true of the flowers in which the lilies and other trees are in bloom.
22.translation: It is surrounded by wonderful gardens and other places. How about the ghosts. It was surrounded by flocks of chirping twins and anxious flocks of birds. The same is true of the flowers in which the lilies and other trees are in bloom.

23.word_for_word: किं च जुष्टम् इति । — And what’s the juice?; हरिणीनाम् इवाक्षीणि यासां ताभिः । — They had eyes like those of deer.; तद् ऐश्वर्यं दृष्ट्वा वितर्कितवांस् तदाह---किम् इदम् इति । — Seeing that opulence he argued and said, "What is this?"; प्रथमं तेजः-पुञ्जं दृष्ट्वा किम् इदम् इति पश्चाद् विमानानि दृष्ट्वा कस्य चेति स्थणं स्वीयम् इति ज्ञात्वा कथं तद् इदं स्थानम् इत्य् एवं रूपम् अभूद् इति ॥२३॥ — First he saw the beam of effulgence and asked what it was, then he saw the airplanes and asked whose place it was, and he knew how it was that this place had thus assumed its form.
23.translation: And what’s the juice? They had eyes like those of deer. Seeing that opulence he argued and said, "What is this?" First he saw the beam of effulgence and asked what it was, then he saw the airplanes and asked whose place it was, and he knew how it was that this place had thus assumed its form.

24.word_for_word: अमर-प्रभास् तत् तुल्यकान्तयः । — The immortal lights are equally beautiful.; प्रत्यगृह्णन्न् उपायनादिभिर् आदृतवन्तः ॥२४॥ — They received them and honored them with gifts and so on.
24.translation: The immortal lights are equally beautiful. They received them and honored them with gifts and so on.

25.word_for_word: उद्भूतो हर्षो यस्याः सा । — She whose joy has arisen.; अति-सम्भ्रम आदरो यस्याः । — whose respect is over-excited.; आलयात् कमल-वनाद् रूप-धारिणी श्री-र् इव । — She is like the goddess of fortune who assumes the form of a lotus forest from her abode.; स्वर्गस्य तत्र भगवता आनीतत्वात् स्वर्गिणाम् इव तयो रूपं च बभूवेति भावः ॥२५॥ — This means that since the Supreme Personality of Godhead brought the heavenly planets there they became like the heavenly planets.
25.translation: She whose joy has arisen. whose respect is over-excited. She is like the goddess of fortune who assumes the form of a lotus forest from her abode. This means that since the Supreme Personality of Godhead brought the heavenly planets there they became like the heavenly planets.

26.word_for_word: बुद्ध्या अयम् एव वन्द्य इति निश्चयेन । — With intelligence, he is certainly the one to be worshipped.; मनसा सङ्कल्पेन ॥२६-२८॥ — by the mind and the resolution.26-2
26.translation: With intelligence, he is certainly the one to be worshipped. by the mind and the resolution.26-2

29.word_for_word: यत्र मन्दिरे पयः फेन-निभाः शय्या आस्तरणानीत्य्-आदि-संपदस् तत्र सर्व-संपदां समृद्धीर् विलोक्य तर्कयाम् आसेति चतुर्थेनान्वयः । — The fourth consequence is that where in the temple there were milk, foam, beds, blankets, etc., and the prosperity of all the possessions, he was arguing.; यत्र च दान्ता गज-दन्त-मयाः पर्यङ्काः ॥२९॥ — There are also beds made of elephant teeth
29.translation: The fourth consequence is that where in the temple there were milk, foam, beds, blankets, etc., and the prosperity of all the possessions, he was arguing. There are also beds made of elephant teeth

30.word_for_word: यत्रासनानि च मृदून्य् उपस्तरणानि तूलादि-मयानि येषु तानि । — There were soft seats and cushions made of cotton and other materials.; यत्र मूक्ता-दाम-विलम्बवन्ति द्युमन्ति च वितानानि ॥३०-३१॥ — where pearl ropes hang and the canopies shine.30-3
30.translation: There were soft seats and cushions made of cotton and other materials. where pearl ropes hang and the canopies shine.30-3

32.word_for_word: स ब्राह्मणो निर्व्यग्रः सन् स्थिरः सन् अहैतुकीम् आकस्मिकीं स्वस्य समृद्धिं तर्कयाम् आस कुत एषा समृद्धिर् आगतेति ॥३२॥ — That brahmin remained undisturbed and steady in reasoning about his unreasonable and sudden prosperity, saying, "Where did this prosperity come from?"
32.translation: That brahmin remained undisturbed and steady in reasoning about his unreasonable and sudden prosperity, saying, "Where did this prosperity come from?"

33.word_for_word: निश्चिनोति, नूनम् इति । — He decides, surely.; एतन् ममेति । — This is mine.; एष चासाव् अहं च तस्यैतन् मम । — This is Chasav and I am his and this is mine.; महती विभूतिर् यस्य तस्यावलोकाद् अन्यः ॥३३॥ — There is no other than the sight of him who has great splendour.
33.translation: He decides, surely. This is mine. This is Chasav and I am his and this is mine. There is no other than the sight of him who has great splendour.

34.word_for_word: ननु स चेद् अवलोकन-मात्रेण महद्-ऐश्वर्यं दत्तवांस् तर्हीदं तुभ्यं मया दत्तम् इति किं नावोचदत आह---नन्व् इति । — If, indeed, he gave you great wealth by mere observation, why didn’t he say, “I have given you this?” He replied, “No.”; ननु मे सखा समक्षम् अब्रुवाण एव याचिष्णवे याचकाय भूरि बह्व् अपि दिशते ददाति । — Indeed, my friend gives a lot of directions to the beggar without speaking in front of him.; अत्र हेतुः, भूरि-भोजः स्वयं तद् देयं पर्जन्य-वद् ईक्षमाण इति । — The reason for this is that the abundant food itself is to be paid, looking at it as if it were rain.; अयम् अर्थः, स्वयं तावद् भूरि-भोजो बहु-भोज आप्त-कामत्वाल् लक्ष्मी-पतित्वाच् च । — This means that he himself eats so much, that he eats so much, that he is satisfied with his desires, and that he is the husband of Lakshmi.; अतो यथा पारावार-परिपूरकोऽति-वदान्यः पर्जन्यः कदाचिद् बह्व् अपि वर्षम् अल्पम् एव च मन्यमानो लज्जयेव समक्षम् अवर्षन्नात्रौ निद्राणे कर्षके तत् क्षेत्रम् आप्लावयति, — Therefore, just as the very generous rain, which supplementes the mercury, sometimes, considering the rain to be much and little, does not rain in front of the shameful rain, but floods the field while the farmer is asleep at night,; एव श्री-कृष्णोऽपि स्व-भोगापेक्षया तद् देयम् इन्द्रादि-पदम् अप्य् अति-तुच्छं मन्वानस् तस्य च भजनं बहु मन्यमानः समक्षम् अब्रुवाण एव ददातीति ॥३४॥ — Similarly, Lord Kṛṣṇa, who considers even the position of Indra and others to be given to Him to be very insignificant in comparison to His own enjoyment, and who considers His devotion to be great, gives it without speaking in His presence.
34.translation: If, indeed, he gave you great wealth by mere observation, why didn’t he say, “I have given you this?” He replied, “No.” Indeed, my friend gives a lot of directions to the beggar without speaking in front of him. The reason for this is that the abundant food itself is to be paid, looking at it as if it were rain. This means that he himself eats so much, that he eats so much, that he is satisfied with his desires, and that he is the husband of Lakshmi. Therefore, just as the very generous rain, which supplementes the mercury, sometimes, considering the rain to be much and little, does not rain in front of the shameful rain, but floods the field while the farmer is asleep at night, Similarly, Lord Kṛṣṇa, who considers even the position of Indra and others to be given to Him to be very insignificant in comparison to His own enjoyment, and who considers His devotion to be great, gives it without speaking in His presence.

35.word_for_word: तद् एवाह---किञ्चिद् इति । — That’s what he said, something.; उरु बह्व् अपि स्व-दत्तं यत् किञ्चित् करोऽत्य्-अल्पं मन्यते । — Uru thinks that whatever he has given himself is too little.; सुहृत्-कृतं फल्ग्व् अति-तुच्छम् अपि भूरि-कारी बहु-मन्यत इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that even the most insignificant falgv done by a friend is considered very important by the Bhuri-kari.; अत एव मयोपनीतं समीपं नीतम् । — That’s why I brought it closer.; प्रीति-युतः स्वयम् एव प्रतिगृहीतवान् ॥३५॥ — He received it himself with pleasure.
35.translation: That’s what he said, something. Uru thinks that whatever he has given himself is too little. This means that even the most insignificant falgv done by a friend is considered very important by the Bhuri-kari. That’s why I brought it closer. He received it himself with pleasure.

36.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्णस्य भक्त-वात्सल्यं दृष्ट्वा तद् भक्तिं प्रार्थयते---तस्येति । — Seeing the affection of Lord Kṛṣṇa for His devotees, one prays for His devotion.; सौहृदं प्रेम । — Friendship is love.; सख्यं हिताशंसनं च । — Friendship and good wishes.; मैत्री उपकारिकत्वं च । — Friendship and helpfulness.; दास्यं सेवकत्वम् । — Slavery is being a servant.; तत्-समाहार एक-वचनम् । — That-combination is a singular.; तस्य तत् सम्बन्धिनो मे मम स्यान् न तु विभूतिः । — I would have that relationship with him, not the glory.; किं च महानुभावेन तेनैव विषज्जतो विशेषण सङ्गं प्राप्नुवतस् तद् भक्तेषु प्रकृष्टः सङ्गः स्याद् इति ॥३६॥ — What is more, one who is attached to that very power by His great power and who attains special attachment to Him will have an excellent attachment to His devotees.
36.translation: Seeing the affection of Lord Kṛṣṇa for His devotees, one prays for His devotion. Friendship is love. Friendship and good wishes. Friendship and helpfulness. Slavery is being a servant. That-combination is a singular. I would have that relationship with him, not the glory. What is more, one who is attached to that very power by His great power and who attains special attachment to Him will have an excellent attachment to His devotees.

37.word_for_word: ननु भक्तेः फलं संपदं प्राप्य पुनर् भक्तिं किम् इति प्रार्थयसेऽत आह---भक्तायेति । — If, indeed, you have obtained the fruits of devotion and wealth, what is it that you pray for devotion again?; संपदः कोशादीन् नाज्यम् ऐश्वर्यं विभूतीः कलत्र-पुत्रादीन् न समर्थयति न ददाति, अपि तु दृढां भक्तिम् एव । — Wealth, treasures, wealth, glory, wife and children do not support or give, but only strong devotion.; कुतः । — Where is it from?; अदीर्घ-बोधाय । — For the short-term understanding.; अविवेकिनो मम तु भक्त्य्-अभावाद् एवं जातम्, अतस् तद् भक्तिर् एव स्याद् इति भावः ॥३७॥ — But this has happened to the irrational because of the lack of devotion to Me, therefore that would be devotion, this means.
37.translation: If, indeed, you have obtained the fruits of devotion and wealth, what is it that you pray for devotion again? Wealth, treasures, wealth, glory, wife and children do not support or give, but only strong devotion. Where is it from? For the short-term understanding. But this has happened to the irrational because of the lack of devotion to Me, therefore that would be devotion, this means.

38.word_for_word: त्यक्ष्यन् शनैः सनैस् त्यागम् अभ्यस्यन् । — They will slowly give up and practice renunciation.; जायया सह बुभुजे ॥३८॥ — He ate with his wife.
38.translation: They will slowly give up and practice renunciation. He ate with his wife.

39.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्णस्यैवं ब्रह्मण्यता नाति-चित्रम् इत्य् आह---तस्येति ॥३९॥ — It is not very surprising that Sri Krishna is thus devoted to the Absolute Truth.
39.translation: It is not very surprising that Sri Krishna is thus devoted to the Absolute Truth.

40.word_for_word: अन्यैर् अजितम् अपि स्व-भृत्यैः पराजितं दृष्ट्वा तस्य ध्यानं तस्य वेगस् तेनोद्ग्रथितम् आत्म-वन्धनम् अहङ्कारो यस्य सः । — Seeing him defeated by his own servants even though he was invincible by others his meditation is his speed and his ego is his self-boundness which is knotted together by him; गतिम् इत्य्-आविष्ट-लिङ्गं धाम-विशेषणम् । — The gender involved in movement is the adjective of the abode.; सतां ब्रह्म-विदां प्राप्यम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥४०॥ — This means that it is attainable by the virtuous who know the Absolute Truth.
40.translation: Seeing him defeated by his own servants even though he was invincible by others his meditation is his speed and his ego is his self-boundness which is knotted together by him The gender involved in movement is the adjective of the abode. This means that it is attainable by the virtuous who know the Absolute Truth.

41.word_for_word: एतत् पृथुकोपाख्यानं श्रुत्वा तत्र ब्रह्मण्यतां विशेषतः श्रुत्वेति ॥४१॥ — Hearing this extensive narrative, one should become a Brahmin there, especially after hearing it.
41.translation: Hearing this extensive narrative, one should become a Brahmin there, especially after hearing it.
